thread:
maria-support: Heads up — customer #C-9842 says our autorouter invoked settle_charge instead of issue_refund. They lost $42.50. Filing here for triage.

maria-support: Initial ticket + minimal repro attached: customer sent refund request w/ amount and reason only. No transaction_id.

maria-support: Example payload we received: 
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-9842",
  "amount": 42.5,
  "reason": "duplicate charge"
}
```

devon-eng: Thanks — looking now. Can you paste router debug for that request? need tool candidates + scores.

maria-support: Pasted debug below (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool_candidates": [
    {"name": "settle_charge", "score": 0.72, "schema": ["amount", "transaction_id?"]},
    {"name": "issue_refund", "score": 0.68, "schema": ["amount", "reason"]}
  ],
  "chosen": "settle_charge",
  "heuristic": "legacy-preference"
}
```

devon-eng: Ah — settle_charge has slightly higher model score and we still have a legacy tie-breaker that prefers charges for money operations. That explains it.

sara-ml: Model is giving close scores. With amount-only payload settle_charge is technically compatible. We need a disambiguator in schema or a higher OOS penalty for tools with optional tx_id.

james-sre: Ops-bot shows this hit a high-severity SLA alert at 12:03 UTC. Customer escalated to priority.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rolling deploy 2026.3.1 in progress to prod; routers v2.4.7.

devon-eng: Short-term patch: add a rule in router.conf to prefer tools with "refund" in their description when intent contains "refund" keywords. I'll open a quick PR.

maria-support: Good. Customer wants immediate reversal — can we manually trigger issue_refund for this account and reverse settle?

james-sre: I'll run a manual rollback + refund path. ETA ~20m. Logging steps: `api: /tools/invoke issue_refund {customer_id, amount, reason, invoked_by: support}`.

sara-ml: Long-term: we should train model with synthetic negative examples where settle_charge looks similar but should lose to issue_refund when refund intent words present. Also add an explicit "operation" enum to authorize which tool to call.

devon-eng: Agreed. I'll add a unit test for this case: payload w/ amount+reason should map >95% to issue_refund. Pushed draft PR #3782.

maria-support: Awesome. Please ping when deployed so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:

devon-eng: Will do. For tracking: created support ticket link: https://redwood/help/C-9842 and internal bug RB-1129.

james-sre: Refund executed and reversal queued. Notifying customer. :white_check_mark:

maria-support: Thanks all. Follow-ups: add router rule, model augmentation, and an integration test.

sara-ml: Filed ML task ML-214 (augment training set) and will scope quant + eval to avoid regressions.

devon-eng: Leaving a small postmortem note in #postmortems after full rollout. :eyes:
